bills.title: COAG Reform Fund Amendment (No Electric Vehicle Taxes) Bill 2020

name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2021-06-21.13.1) "*That the question be now put.*" In other words, they voted to [vote on whether to read the bill for a second time](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/divisions/senate/2021-06-21/2) immediately rather than debating the matter any further.
